title: TnT explodes on Ground
description: This data pack makes it impossible for tnt to explode while falling, it will only start its cooldown when it lands
body:
This small datapack makes tnt only explode when it is on the ground. This means its fuse will not run while falling. This might be useful for clearing large areas with tnt flying machines. It will break world eaters.

Join the dc server for updates and suggestions!
